verdict.rationale: Morph documents Dedicated Endpoints: you reserve model capacity by choosing a model and plan, Morph provisions and operates it, and you connect through a dedicated endpoint URL. That separates the workload from the shared serverless API. Autoscaling is never mentioned, and the docs don't describe GPU hardware choices or isolation guarantees. missing for 10: documented autoscaling on dedicated endpoints, explicit GPU hardware/capacity details, an explicit statement of isolation from the shared serverless pool, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: Reserve model capacity by choosing a model and plan. Morph provisions and operates it; once ready, connect an OpenAI client using the endpoint's URL and served model name.
